title: Theatrical
description: The concept is a grand, stagey manner of speaking: dramatic flourishes, exclamations, and poetic phrasing that heighten the delivery. It is contrasted with the same content said plainly, in an ordinary, unheightened register. Contrast: the same content said plainly.
